name: Orchard Surgery

road_access.notes: On Commercial Road (B1147), Toftwood. Traffic signals at Commercial Road / Norwich Street junction 130m north (52.680313, 0.943950). Lift gate on rear boundary — private access only.

entrances.label: Main entrance (Commercial Road)
entrances.coord_source: OSM way centroid — entrance node not separately tagged
entrances.notes: Faces Commercial Road. Dereham Pharmacy co-located on site (east end of building, 52.679651, 0.943750).

bus_stops.label: London Road, opp
bus_stops.notes: Closest stop to surgery, ~250m south-west on London Road.

delivery.internal_road_notes: Small surgery building. No internal road. Park on Commercial Road or use Dencora motorcycle/car park area.
delivery.notes: Rear boundary has private lift gate — not for delivery use. Traffic signals at Norwich Street junction 130m north.
